title: 水下機器人浮力材料
summary: 比較浮材密度、吸水、壓縮與質量帳，以量測證據判斷淨浮力變化。 在浮材試片與常壓浮力模型室依十個單元完成機制觀察、定量比較、量測驗證與故障診斷；各算例為獨立教學假設，完整保留資料來源與模型限制。
summaryEn: Compare density, water uptake, compression and mass accounting to interpret net-buoyancy changes. Complete ten units of mechanisms, quantitative comparisons, measurement verification and diagnosis in the Buoyancy coupons and ambient float studio. Examples are independent teaching assumptions with sources and model limitations retained.
scope: 依公開原理編寫的原創船舶海洋教學。數值均為明示假設，不是同名船舶的實測規格、法規認證或實船操作參數。以虛構資料、教學模型與常壓桌面練習學習，排除武器、戰術與載人下潛操作。
scopeEn: Original marine teaching based on public principles. All numbers are explicit assumptions, not measured named-vessel specifications, certification criteria or real-ship operating parameters. Learning uses synthetic data, teaching models and unpressurized desktop exercises, excluding weapons, tactics and crewed diving operations.

steps.title: 乾態浮材的淨浮力：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Net buoyancy of dry material: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 乾態浮材的淨浮力 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Net buoyancy of dry material and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 在「水下機器人浮力材料」的「乾態浮材的淨浮力」中，淨浮力是排水重與自身重的差，符號決定靜水趨勢。 本單元須將作用機制畫成有輸入、輸出與邊界的圖，並核對是否符合本課問題：比較浮材密度、吸水、壓縮與質量帳，以量測證據判斷淨浮力變化。
steps.instructionEn: Within Underwater-robot buoyancy materials, Net buoyancy of dry material examines this mechanism: Net buoyancy is displaced-water weight minus self-weight; its sign sets the static tendency. Draw inputs, outputs and boundaries, then relate it to the course question: Compare density, water uptake, compression and mass accounting to interpret net-buoyancy changes.
steps.observation: 本單元為獨立假想教學台架，不可將不同單元數值拼成真實船舶規格。輸入：ρwater=1025 kg/m³，ρmaterial=600 kg/m³，V=0.02 m³。關係式 Fnet=(ρw−ρm)gV；含單位換算算式 (1025-600)*9.81*0.02 = 83.385 N。適用條件：不含壓縮、吸水或深度循環；不能當材料耐深認證。
steps.observationEn: This unit is an independent hypothetical teaching bench; values from different units must not be combined into vessel specifications. Inputs: Water density 1025 kg/m³, material density 600 kg/m³ and volume 0.02 m³. Relation Fnet=(ρw−ρm)gV; expression including unit conversion (1025-600)*9.81*0.02 = 83.385 N. Applicability: Excludes compression, water uptake and depth cycling; not depth certification.
steps.failure: 本單元先檢查以下替代原因：吸水增加質量但未同步更改浮力帳會高估餘裕。 比較它和輸入真正變動時會出現的觀察差別。
steps.failureEn: First examine this alternative cause: Water uptake without updating mass accounting overestimates buoyancy reserve. Compare its observable pattern with a genuine change in the input.
steps.check: 對「乾態浮材的淨浮力」，分列乾重、吸水後重與體積變化，不把密度當常數。 保存原始觀察和推導，不以師傅輔助完成標記代替證據。
steps.checkEn: For Net buoyancy of dry material, Separate dry/wet mass and volume change rather than assuming constant density. Retain raw observations and derivation; an assisted-completion marker does not replace evidence.
